# Dilemma v3.2.0

The person who starts a random quiz can now close that quiz with the button or `/dilemma poll end`, without a management role. Store the creator ID so this access survives restarts. Managers retain access to all quizzes; creator access does not extend to scheduled quizzes or other people's random quizzes. Older random quizzes without a recorded creator still require a manager.

Remove the unused `@neon/env` dependency, obsolete help introduction translations and a duplicate avatar asset. Update six-language help and privacy documentation.

Apply `20261026120000_random_quiz_creator`, regenerate the Prisma client and re-register Discord commands. The migration adds one nullable field and preserves existing quiz records. Early closing continues to preserve quotas and finalized-vote scoring.
